gameName: Age of Dirt: A Game of Uncivilization
firstPlayerRule: Whoever has the longest hair takes the first turn.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The starting instruction appears at the end of player setup. Players then take consecutive turns, choosing one action on their turn.
When order matters during an event, drum use or resource collection, the active player decides first and the others follow clockwise.
